prompt: As of Aug 3, 2024, the artist who released the album "Father of Asahd" went to the same high school as an Olympic diver. How many Olympic teams did this diver participate on?
answer: DJ Khaled attended Dr. Phillips High School in Orlando, as did Olympic diver **Megan Neyer**. Neyer participated on **one U.S. Olympic team**, competing at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics.
